newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Astrologer held for seeing Venezuelan's downfall.
newsitem.headline: Astrologer held for seeing Venezuelan's downfall.

text.p: An astrologer who predicted the political downfall of Venezuelan President Rafael Caldera has been detained for questioning, officials said on Wednesday.
Interior Minister Jose Guillermo Andueza said the secret police DISIP were investigating the "political implications" of the astrologer's prediction.
Jose Bernardo Gomez recently told a conference of bankers, businessman and politicians that "Caldera will not pass 1997."
The astrologer did not specify the reason Caldera would not complete his term, which ends in early 1999. Caldera, now serving his second presidential term, will be 81 in January.
"The coincidences between the horoscopes of Caldera and of Venezuela are so great that next year appears in both as the end of an era in the nation's life," Gomez said in an article.
Gomez is president of Venezuela's astrologers association and according to followers is one of the best in his field.
Among his celebrated predictions was that of Caldera's surprise election triumph in 1993.
